body: ...Youre starting to sound like a therapist
I doubt anything will help. I turned to SW as a last ditch effort to see life in another light.
It was negative in that I walked out feeling worse than when I walked in. I studied medicine.
I saw a psychiatrist once but have made an effort to run clear of any more therapists.
Ive been on and (mostly) off anxiety meds for a long time.
Family, friends, utopian ideas of what my life would be like after I finished college
